name: Omelette of Breadcrumbs
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Beat the eggs, adding finely chopped garlic and parsley successively.
Add breadcrumbs, making sure the mixture is uniform.
Cook the omelette over low heat with a few drops of cooking oil to prevent sticking.

culture.text: The omelette of breadcrumbs (in Spanish, tortilla de pan rallado) is a traditional recipe from Málaga, Spain. The origins of the recipe are uncertain and diverse. The Romans cooked an omelette shaped cake which they called ovorum torta. The omelette recipe "with milk", with honey and ground black pepper, collected by Apicius, reveals his age.
